# Cataracts

## What are cataracts?

A cataract is a cloudy area in the lens of the eye. Cataracts are very common as people get older.

## What's the treatment for cataracts?

Surgery is the only way to get rid of a cataract. The surgeon replaces the cloudy lens with an artificial lens.

### Before surgery

Brighter lights and anti-glare sunglasses can help early on.
